notes: Garment identity uses exact path and SHA; IDs repeat across characters/views.
Named clothing presets leave hair and face independently selected; a clothing-only preview should not imply it is a complete authored head-to-toe look.
The 88 clothing preset rows include seven original/bare views and duplicate paired representation aliases. They are not 88 unique designs.
The 113 active files include palettes, views and revisions.
Three selectable garment items have no declared preset and must be shown individually.
Current pixel conversion is a derived algorithmic option; its unbounded grid/palette combinations are not new authored outfits.
Theme bundles are baked complete variants, not modular garment items.
Do not apply paired appearance banks to unrelated source/registration groups.
Gallery previews should use the actual runtime compositor or existing hash-bound exports.
